evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A single seven-stage detection pipeline serves both SQL and GraphQL targets; a zero-LLM deterministic mode delivers 100% execution accuracy at a median latency of 3.2 ms with no API cost; and every generated query carries a runtime confidence score in [0.15, 0.97] computed from an additive signal model.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: An ablation study isolates schema-aware prompting as the dominant accuracy lever, contributing +18.4 percentage points of exact-match gain over the schema-free baseline on both benchmarks. text2ql is publicly available at https://pypi.org/project/text2ql/ under the Apache 2.0 license.
